payload.text: Easy now, friends. The gulls are circling low and the tide's turning sour, bad omens for someone in this square. I've no suspicions yet, just a lookout's eye. Hugo, Umar, I'll be listening close to how you speak. Let's hear every voice before we cast any blame.
